artifact.caption_claim: The implemented coordination core uses five evidence-producing or review roles, an append-only sealed blackboard, and a separate deterministic adjudicator that selects a safe executable candidate or abstains.
supported_manuscript_claims: The implemented coordination core uses five evidence-producing or review roles, an append-only sealed blackboard, and a separate deterministic adjudicator that selects a safe executable candidate or abstains.
limitations: SQL candidates and counterfactual state results are supplied externally; the core does not call a language model or generate SQL itself.
The blackboard records structured handoffs and is not evidence of free-form inter-agent negotiation.
The adjudicator is reference-free and does not access gold SQL.
